emitted.data: Form Builder
User Registration - Step 1 (register_step1)

Requirements: The first step in the user registration process. This screen collects basic user information such as First Name, Last Name, and Email Address. It introduces the user to the registration process and sets expectations for the next steps..
>register_step1
User Registration - Step 2 (register_step2)

Requirements: The second step in the user registration process. This screen is designed to securely collect the user's desired password. It includes fields for Password and Confirm Password, along with password strength indicators and tips for creating a strong password..
>register_step2
User Registration - Step 3 (register_step3)

Requirements: The final step in the user registration process. This screen might include additional optional information, such as Phone Number, Profile Picture, or Marketing Preferences, allowing the user to tailor their experience right from the start..
>register_step3
Registration Confirmation (registration_confirmation)

Requirements: This screen confirms that the user has successfully registered. It includes a welcome message and instructions for verifying their email address or next steps they can take within the application..
>registration_confirmation
